newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Sec loses top spot in TSE trading--sources.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Sec loses top spot in TSE trading--sources.

text.p: The volume of shares traded by Nomura Securities Co Ltd on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) totalled 1.46 billion in March, down 24.9 percent from February, market sources said.
This pushed Nomura from top position among brokerages for the first time since February 1992, they said.
Shares traded by Nomura amounted to 9.2 percent of the TSE's overall trading volume of 7.96 billion shares in March, making it the second-largest.
The top position was taken by Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, which traded 1.53 billion shares or 9.6 percent in March, up 0.1 percent from February, the sources said.
